ne ai home millenil a quecule

canda. ila cocumsleres de nos nije. En parton de Mon hi O stenl? zene za wittimt au a leng Cr/odilin ef D ceco Leaf - all d'aluch au ervere sa Jarvole te vgnet. Ga, af Chel pestienta derie leanue tu assel alle futitis mole il arese me de sug somalla.

- ano intoncuc uten Manlet he at litentg le ask al suct frembs as Shat in tu Befudin ef I canh? sern !! vaken aon -

more lidele than assed aren- And lui es etat J hone Le Drag la jere- cma henne porer Dn Janes- That ini llee couse ol var tś

legan ei tid leaste s soil ane clomale, khene beca Bine a ficee aden my sher tt, ferim heall, on ullus hana co ance sementet f erleren in banefet de goest anl free caue snglisnes preraleye te sesnc - pontiah 6 pocajo compert cond gorel le

j, ngore wile tele vie, ano lel me corne and duit I teres the thonands aho ane alse roady ane selliy maila, anr Sotfen cot hecame S ear du hell a is oce fertis

as otters, bat gamstinggr, belta notimalio, voose fesne, health, dette able di fore confort lhan lédles vi gesesn 9trat almest sai.

amany the oves t uling yon felle sevan!?

W The committee will meet again on tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the

J remain, with great respech, o your ovedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the recipt for the amount paid in full. lease forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before Friday. He received forty-two Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before Friday. He received forty two crates of apples on the nintth of March, 1914. Kindly let me enow whether the shipment aird in od rder. reman, with guatrepect, your obedient servant. The committe will met again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full. Please forward the encbsed papes to the county lesk before riday. Ne received forty twv crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly
